name: Ga nuong muoi cheo
summary: Chicken grilled until firm and golden, served with sticky rice and a dish of muối cheo, Phong Nha’s dipping salt.
texture: The meat is firm and grills to gold.
howToEat: Dip the chicken in muối cheo and eat it with the sticky rice.
At Mooc Spring, the platter brings free-range chicken with mountain-stream shrimp and freshwater fish.
seoTitle: Ga nuong muoi cheo — grilled chicken, Phong Nha
seoDescription: Gà nướng muối cheo is Phong Nha’s grilled chicken, firm and golden, with sticky rice and muối cheo for dipping.
